title: Al Dorne Special in Illustration Magazine
content: Illustrator Albert Dorne is the subject of an entire special issue of Illustration Magazine. Dorne founded the Famous Artists School and worked for decades in the lucrative field of advertising illustration.Dorne was also a major influence on the artists for Mad Magazine, such as Jack Davis.The 80-page issue includes a detailed biography, richly illustrated with dozens of examples of his artwork.Illustration Magazine Special on Al Dorne80 pages, 8.5 x 11, perfect bound, printed in full color.
